title: Engineering Intelligence: Data, Digital, and AI in Action
session_title: Engineering Intelligence: Data, Digital, and AI in Action
abstract: This session will feature a series of flash presentations from colleagues across our healthcare, life sciences, and electronics businesses. We’ll be showcasing how EMD’s uniquely diverse portfolio is being transformed through the power of data science, digital platforms, and AI—from accelerating drug discovery and enabling precision medicine, to advancing smart materials and digital biology. Students will also be invited to participate in a digital internship challenge that allows them to apply their skills to meaningful, cross-disciplinary problems.
